title: Honorificabilitudinitatibus
html_source:
The longest single word in Shakespeare’s works, used in Love’s Labour’s Lost Act V, Scene 1:

I marvel thy master hath not eaten thee for a word; for thou art not so long by the head as honorificabilitudinitatibus: thou art easier swallowed than a flap-dragon.

The word means “the state of being able to achieve honors.”
